pieces.name: main_2story
pieces.notes: 2-story main, crest runs N-S (house frame) at u 232, LiDAR z 36 from the north eave to about v 190. South end is hipped (big south face z 24 at v 223); north end reads as a gable (east face continues to the north eave).

pieces.name: east_cross
pieces.notes: 2-story cross hip running east from the main crest, ridge E-W at v 108 (LiDAR z 32), north face z 27, east hip end z 25-27. Dark trapezoid at the top is its north face.

pieces.name: sw_wing
pieces.notes: front wing at the west end read as a shed: LiDAR crest z 28 sits on its north edge (v 167) and the roof falls at 11-12/12 to a 1-story eave at v 248 (z 16 at v 229, z 23.5 at v 195). High edge runs E-W and dies into the main west face near u 170. Only a 3 ft north return exists (z 27 face at v 156). Porch roof at u 28-72 v 150-195 is part of it.

pieces.name: ne_garage
pieces.notes: 1-story hip at the NE end, ridge E-W, faces z 13-15; dark triangle at the east edge is its hip end.

pieces.name: se_wing
pieces.notes: SE wing, ridge E-W at v 194 (LiDAR z 23), south face z 21, north face z 19.6. Eave about 15 ft, so it is taller than a normal 1-story; valleys run from the main block into it.

exclude_notes: dark ground west of the main block
shadow band north of the eave
notes: Long rotated ranch (long axis 19 deg clockwise of E). 2-story main with a N-S crest and an east cross hip, 1-story garage at the east end, SE wing, and a steep front wing at the west end. Confidence MED-LOW: the main crest is far too long for a hip of this width so I read the north end as a gable; the sw_wing roof geometry (ridge almost on its north edge per LiDAR) does not match a simple gable and may be a saltbox or shed. Frame: rotate 19 deg CCW about (560,566), crop 500x300.
